species.real: The tides racing through the Pentland Firth now turn the underwater turbines of the MeyGen project, one of the world's first large tidal power schemes.
species.name: Swelklet

dex.text: A little whirl of grey sea with a round stone in the middle, spinning. It hums while it turns, and anything that falls in goes round and round for a while before it comes out again, dizzy.
dex.fact: The Pentland Firth between Caithness and Orkney has some of the fastest tidal streams around Britain, racing between the Atlantic and the North Sea.

species.real: In the Norse tale the magic quern Grotti was turned by two giantesses, Fenja and Menja, forced to grind without rest; they ground out an army to get their revenge.
species.name: Swelkie

dex.text: A whirlpool with a millstone for a heart, grinding away at the bottom of the sea. Boats give it a wide berth. Gulls ride it round for fun.
dex.fact: The Swelkie is a whirlpool off the island of Stroma. Norse legend says it is the sea pouring through the hole of the magic quern Grotti, which grinds salt on the seabed, and that is why the sea is salt.
